dreamteamer.title: Files
dreamteamer.description: The files under mounted folders as records. A `file-drives` record names one folder as a `${env:…}` template and the subfolders it indexes; `dt files sync` walks it and keeps one `files` record per file or folder — path, size, modified, hash, a text preview, and which records point at it — adding, updating, marking missing and renaming on a move, never writing your description, tags and notes.
